svg.title: Reach, not the graph: graphical abstract
svg.desc: Left: in the usual comparison the GNN sees 22.7 km and the SLX baseline 12.6 km. Middle: this study gives the GNN, the same network without a graph and SLX models the same reach. Right: skill against reach; all models rise and level off on one curve near the target correlation length, so at equal reach the graph adds nothing.
svg.text: Why do graph neural networks beat simple spatial models in mapping urban NO₂?
Intra-urban NO₂ hotspots from TROPOMI, Tehran, 2,436 cells of 1 km
The GNN wins, but sees farther:
graph and reach differ at once
at equal reach the graph adds nothing
